name: com.netpulse.unity
description: NetPulse client for Unity: a Photon-like networking solution with a simple async API, rooms, lobby, RPCs, synced objects and server plugins.

samples.description: Connect, lobby list, create/join room, generated RPCs, SyncVar health, a typed chat message, a typed RoomKey score, tick-based movement, master-only scene loading, a shared takeover cube (IMGUI).
